description: This file defines a service module for handling CRUD operations related to connectors in a backend system. It provides functions to create, list, retrieve, update, and delete connector records, wrapping underlying database functions.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_connector_record( tenant_id: str, provider: str, auth_method: str, label: str | None, config: Dict[str, Any], token_id: str | None, )
methods.description: Creates a new connector record with specified properties and returns the created record.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_connector_records(tenant_id: str | None = None)
methods.description: Lists all connector records, optionally filtered by tenant ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any]|None get_connector_record(connector_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a single connector record by ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any]|None update_connector_record(connector_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing connector record identified by ID with provided updates.

methods.name: bool delete_connector_record(connector_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a connector record by ID.
